title: Cancellation and hold
summary: Host abort retains custody until the interrupted case records starting_state_restore cleanup evidence. A declared baseline requires restored=true for that baseline; an as_is case or chain without a baseline settles on its no-restore receipt. Other roster cases do not impose restore requirements. Missing proof, failed cleanup or failed required restoration retains custody and names operator recovery. Member removal and run takeover record the same abort instead of finishing such an execution, and run cancellation leaves an abort already recorded to its own cleanup; a removed mission walk holding its machine settles only through its walk-end teardown (qa_abort_walk_end_required). The original session can abort or finish mission walk-end after the deployment run is terminal. Abort records the run status in its release reason; an already-settled execution reports its state instead of an active-stage recovery. Normal writes still require the active stage.
